answer: Yes. POST /v1/completions/batch accepts 1 to 100 check-in items in one request, and each item carries its own habit_id.
explanation: R83 defines the batch body as items with their own habit_id, 1 to 100 per request. R84 and R85 say items are processed in order and a rejected item never stops the others. The route is registered in the code, but I cannot quote a code line, so I leave it as unverified.

citations.quote: `POST /v1/completions/batch` takes `{items: [{id, habit_id, date, note?}, ...]}` with 1 to 100 items
A batch processes its items in order, each exactly as a single check-in create would
A batch item that is rejected writes nothing, and never stops the other items.
